images.prompt:
ICSB
I (Image Type): pitch-deck style infographic / 2D matrix diagram (16:9), designed for blog readability

- X-axis: Misleading / Emotional Manipulation (LOW -> HIGH)
- Y-axis: Information Withheld (LOW -> HIGH)
Show 4 quadrants with short English labels:
- bottom-left: "BLIND SPOT\n(Too Bland)"
- bottom-right: "HYPE\n(Emotional, Not Hidden)"
- top-left: "ETHICAL CLICKBAIT\n(Curiosity, Accurate)" (highlight with a subtle glow)
- top-right: "CLICK TRAP\n(Misleading + Mystery)"
Add a small callout arrow pointing to "ETHICAL CLICKBAIT" with caption: "Sweet spot: curiosity without deception".
S (Style): modern pitch deck layout (like the reference slide): big clean title at top ("Clickbait Map"), generous whitespace, soft shadows, rounded corners, geometric icons optional, crisp sans-serif typography, mobile-readable
B (Brand Layer): alici.ai green-centered palette (deep emerald -> mint accents), white/very-light background, restrained color use, NO blue/purple, professional and modern

images.prompt:
ICSB
I (Image Type): pitch-deck style flowchart / loop diagram (16:9), designed for blog readability
C (Content): a 5-step loop with large numbered nodes and short English labels:
1) "Make 3 Variants" (A/B/C thumbnails)
2) "Publish"
3) "Watch Metrics" (Impressions / CTR / First-30s Retention)
4) "Change ONE Variable" (face OR text OR main subject)
5) "Log & Pick Winner"
Use arrows forming a loop from 5 back to 1.
Include a small side note box (English): "Don't change title + thumbnail at the same time".
S (Style): modern pitch deck layout (like the reference slide): rounded cards, soft shadows, clean icons, generous whitespace, crisp sans-serif typography, mobile-readable
B (Brand Layer): alici.ai green accents (emerald/mint), white/very-light background, restrained palette, NO blue/purple, no noisy backgrounds
